exposure: Individual antidepressants (duloxetine, escitalopram, venlafaxine, citalopram, fluoxetine, sertraline, bupropion)
Timing of antidepressant prescription during pregnancy (early pregnancy, third trimester)
cohort: The cohort comprised 3,694 women who received at least one antidepressant prescription from 3 months prior to conception through delivery, and their newborns.
finding: Duloxetine and escitalopram were most strongly associated with any adaptation syndrome and NICU admission, while bupropion and sertraline showed the lowest risks for these outcomes.
